title: An actual accounting register: one teaching entry of 100
goal: Create an original chart/register and reread amount and both sides of one synthetic entry.
prerequisites: onec.p5; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.
outcomes: Actual-register observation tied to own references.
Meaning/analytics checked separately from arithmetic equality.
sections: Equality of sides is an invariant

The teaching model records 100 as a debit to one account and credit to another. Equal aggregate debits/credits do not prove correct account selection; operation meaning and analytics matter. This is not real accounting or tax advice; regulated rules are outside this synthetic example.

Create actual ChartOfAccounts.УчебныеСчета and AccountingRegister.УчебныеПроводки. Select that chart, enable correspondence and add balance resource Сумма: Number(15,2), recorded by ЗаявкаУслуги. This is not an array model. Screenshots show original metadata creation, not third-party configuration.

The chart defines accounts and analytic settings; the accounting register stores movements. They are different objects. A full native exercise requires an original teaching chart/register, not a copied proprietary configuration. An array ofdebit/credit pairs teaches an invariant but does not execute an accounting register.

The function creates two own accounts with different codes and one 100-unit record for its own document. Units are educational, not enterprise accounting advice. A query rereads СчетДт/СчетКт/Сумма filtered by this recorder.

An account can have customer/service analytics under the model. Missing analytics can preserve overall equality while misallocating customers. Add two customers with equal amounts and verify identities. This distinguishes formal side equality from correct accounting meaning.

Amount 100 and both account references are separate checks. Balanced sides do not establish correct business account selection. This minimal example adds no subaccounts/extra analytics; those require their own explicit design and checks, not a statutory-accounting claim.

Post a synthetic operation, reconcile sides/recorder, repeat and reverse. Debit and credit effects must change consistently. Explicitly label evidence as a BSL model, a real register or theoretical analysis. An unavailable permitted stand does not turn the first into actual register execution.

A compilable 101 mutation fails the independent 100 expectation. Repeating/reversing own-recorder effects needs its own case and must preserve other sets. Never use a real bookkeeping base; retain own accounts/document and do not clear the register for appearance.
